purpose: Test whether the corrected Chapter 1 functional island syndrome can emerge from island-flora assembly/colonization filtering under realistic island covariates and visitor assembly, before invoking within-island adaptive evolution.

empirical_covariates.preflight_rule: sample_rank divisible by 4, giving 32 islands per context

visitor_environment.assembly_rule: same fixed outcome-blind global guild pool and distance/climate visitor assembly as v2

mainland_source_pool.climate_center: drawn outcome-blind from empirical island climate vectors
mainland_source_pool.independence: plant traits, seed dispersal, source abundance and climate niche are generated independently except for the declared climate-center sampling

colonization_filter.interpretation: Baker-law/reproductive-assurance and pollinator-access filtering act during flora assembly; species traits are fixed in v3 preflight

empirical_estimands.H2_selfing: occupancy-weighted island selfing_core ~ z(distance)+z(area)+z(climate PC1-4), within context
empirical_estimands.H2_accessibility: occupancy-weighted island generalized_accessible ~ z(distance)+z(selfing_core)+z(area)+z(climate PC1-4), within context
empirical_estimands.H3: occupancy-weighted island mean pollen limitation ~ global z(distance)+context indicators
empirical_estimands.H4_selfing: species-island pollen limitation ~ species assurance_a + global z(distance)+context indicators, weighted by occupancy_probability
empirical_estimands.H4_accessibility: species-island pollen limitation ~ species generalization_g + global z(distance)+context indicators, weighted by occupancy_probability

success_rule.H2: all eight corrected H2 coefficients within empirical estimate +/- 2 SE
success_rule.joint: all eleven calibration coefficients pass without H1 atomic or colour data

planned_controls_if_passes: arrival-only null with reproductive establishment removed
stochastic realized-flora replay instead of expected occupancy weights
optional short in-situ evolution added only after assembly mechanism is established
holdouts: all seven H1 atomic trait slopes
failure_rule: If no v3 region passes, retain the failure and diagnose the remaining mismatch before adding in-situ evolution or trait-specific developmental modules.
claim_boundary: v3 tests contemporary flora assembly/colonization filtering, which is directly aligned with Chapter 1's observed-flora estimand.
Expected occupancy is used only for fast calibration; realized stochastic floras are required for confirmation.
No Chapter 1 trait outcome is used to define source species or visitor guild pools.
A pass would show empirical emulation by a declared assembly mechanism, not historical identification for named islands.
